body_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production animation SOURCE sheet for Rasta Quest side-scrolling game, not a finished native export.
Input image: reference only, existing Chaser knight design. Rebuild the SAME dark steel helmeted knight, single short crimson crest, crimson visor slit, charcoal armor with restrained warm gray edge highlights, torn crimson tabard/cape, no religious symbols. Maintain anatomy and armor proportions in every cell. Polished detailed hand-crafted pixel art, clean clustered shading, no coarse placeholder blocks.
Deliver exactly sixteen complete BODY poses on a perfectly regular 4 by 4 square grid, equal cells, no gutters drawn, generous transparent empty gutters between subjects. All face LEFT in fixed side/three-quarter gameplay view. Same scale, helmet/hips widths, all grounded soles share each cell's baseline; fallen bodies rest on that baseline. NO sword, NO shield, NO object held: fists/forearms visible for separately rigged equipment. No shadows, scenery, labels, captions, glow or motion blur. True transparent background.
Reading left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
Row1: idle relaxed guard; idle slight breathing shift; walk left heel contact (left foot forward); walk down/compression.
Row2: walk passing pose (feet close); opposite foot contact; walk down opposite; walk passing opposite. Six genuinely distinct gait poses total with two alternating planted feet, no skating.
Row3: attack anticipation fist starting to raise; attack anticipation fist high behind helmet and free forearm guarding; active attack fist thrust fully to LEFT at chest height with lunging weight; active follow-through still extended left but lowered slightly.
Row4: nonfatal recoil slight lean back; recoil recovery; collapse on knee; fallen horizontal body on ground facing left.
Hands: sword hand is the forward/left hand in idle and walk, raised behind helmet in tell, thrust to left in active; shield hand is opposite and visibly bent at elbow near torso. Keep bare armored fists clearly readable, avoid crossing both forearms. Same detailed armor every pose. No accessories grow/shrink. Fill roughly 65 percent of each cell height in standing poses. The reference weapons must be omitted because rigid independent art will be attached later. This is one coherent body animation sheet, not unrelated character concepts.
